summary: Verified iteration-18 features (Messages inline edit, Live view dialogs, Flow enabled/disabled + per-pancarte toggles, Timed-flow overlap settings + summary + overflow warning, Vimeo/HLS stream background). Backend: 10/10 pytest tests pass (test_scene_flows_live.py). Frontend: full flow executed with Yannick admin + MFA — login, Messages Bewerk/Opslaan/Annuleer, Scenes 'live-scene-<id>' dialog with iframe pointing to /api/public/scene/<token>/overlay, SceneEditor bg-stream recognises vimeo URL and persists as background.type=stream/stream=vimeo, canvas-flow click opens flow panel with flow-enabled-toggle and per-pancarte toggles, flow-schedule Timed option exposes flow-every/flow-show-seconds, flow-timeline-summary renders 'Every 5 min: shows 15s (2 pancartes × 5s) → closes automatically.', flow-overflow-warning appears when showSeconds>=everyMin*60, '(overlaps start)' and '(overlaps end)' labels present, live-view-btn opens dialog with live-view-surface/live-view-iframe. API GET /scenes/<id> confirms persistence of flows[0].disabledPancartes, flows[0].enabled, flows[0].schedule, and background. Overlay HTML (GET /api/public/scene/<token>/overlay) contains 'on && phase<introSec', 'pl.enabled===false', 'hls.js@1', and 'player.vimeo.com'.
critical_code_review_comments: edit_submission (server.py L1790) correctly scopes by {id, user_id} and returns 404 on no match; raw body['data'] is stored verbatim without per-field validation against form.fields — acceptable for inline-typo fix but allows adding arbitrary keys. Low priority.
expand_scene_flows (L1104) short-circuits pancartes when pl.enabled is False (adds pans=[] to the placement) AND the overlay JS also hides via 'pl.enabled===false' — belt-and-braces is correct.

SceneEditor flow-schedule dropdown uses a Radix Select; the first attempt to pick the Timed option by get_by_text('Timed') erroneously targeted the sidebar 'Timed text + photo' button. Not a bug — just a selector-ambiguity note for future tests (use role=option).

bg-stream Input visually overflows its narrow column (full URL truncated to 'h'); value is correct in the DOM. Consider adding text-overflow:ellipsis or a slightly wider container so operators can confirm the URL at a glance.

Vimeo embed in the Live-view iframe produced console errors 'Permissions policy violation: encrypted-media is not allowed in this document.' Vimeo tries to use EME; the overlay iframe would benefit from allow='autoplay; encrypted-media' when embedded. Low priority (overlay still renders in vMix which is a Chromium Web Browser input with permissive policy).
